name: Professional services firm
description: Clients and contracts, projects with budgets, timesheets at each person's rate, expenses and purchases, hiring, onboarding and time off, for an agency or a consultancy.
expects: For firms of 10 to 50 people who bill clients for their time, in any currency.
leavesOut: Clients don't sign in: Bike is for the firm's own people.
Invoices and the books: they wait for Bike's accounts, in a later version.
Scheduling people onto projects: Bike doesn't keep calendars yet.
Payroll, and connections to accounting or other systems.

slots.name: Partner
slots.does: Approves purchases and offers above the band, and is told when a project goes over its budget.

slots.name: Operations
slots.does: Keeps clients and contracts, hiring, onboarding and time off.

slots.name: Finance
slots.does: Approves expenses and keeps rates and project budgets.

slots.name: Project managers
slots.does: Run projects: they add clients and projects and see the time and spend on them.
